name: Incremental Ray Traversal through OpenVDB Frustum Grids
definition: A method for traversing OpenVDB frustum grids by generalizing the 3D DDA algorithm to account for the non-linearity of the perspective transform, allowing efficient ray traversal for any ray (not just camera rays) without auxiliary grids.
summary: Incremental Ray Traversal through OpenVDB Frustum Grids efficiently traverses frustum-structured voxel data by generalizing the 3D DDA algorithm to handle perspective non-linearity without auxiliary acceleration structures.
